children.text: The video appeals to the audience’s emotions when she mentions the dynamic of her divorced family going out together and jokes about the awkward interactions sometimes they receive. Alix shares a personal family situation which creates an emotional connection with her audience that may have experienced similar hardships. This acknowledgement contrasts with her fun and glamorous lifestyle the public associates her with, making Alix seem more relatable despite her fame and wealth. Her casual delivery of the situation makes the audience feel like its story a friend would mention, reducing the perceived distance between Alix and her audience and strengthening the emotional connection. Her authenticity increases her credibility as audiences view Alix’s personal stories and confessions as genuine, leading to more trust in her recommendations for products and businesses that she overlaps in her content. Audiences may tie her authenticity to the rest of her content, making the more promotional aspects of her content seem less commercially motivated and potentially more persuasive to viewers.

Alix casually mentions dancing with Mick Jagger, creating a contradiction in the relatable persona she has built on her platform. This experience she has is inaccessible to the majority of her audience, which distances her from the audience and demonstrates how being an influencer has affected her life. In the context of her rise to fame, she is no longer as relatable as the typical college girl she first built her content around. However, her tone and the delivery of how she presents her life have stayed the same. The tension between her real life and online persona shows how her relatability with her following is more dependent on how she is sharing her life rather than the exact experiences she has.

Due to Tiktok’s ability for users to quickly swipe through videos, it creates a constraint on Alix as she has to constantly maintain her audiences’ attention in the short video. In a span of 30 seconds, Alix does her makeup and switches between multiple different short summary stories of what recently has occurred in her life. The constant changing of topics reduces the chance audiences lose interest and will scroll away from the video. The platform constraint heavily influences the type of communication between Alix and her followers as the stories alone might not create enough engagement. The multitasking of a GRWM format makes her storytelling more visually stimulating for her viewers to watch the full video.

The video’s message of Alix’s Tiktok is an invitation for viewers to experience her life alongside her. At the end of Alix’s TikTok, she talks about the expansion of Sip Margs nationwide and reinforces that her businesses, Reale Actives and Sig Margs, are integrated within the overall message for her content. The purpose is to inform her viewers while creating exposure for her brands.. By mentioning Sip Margs’ expansion at the end of her video, viewers have already listened to multiple personal stories which makes the Sip Margs acknowledgement feel more like a casual update than a direct ad. Audiences are more receptive to the promotion through the integration of the personal stories, showing how her followers’ interest in her life creates attention for her business.

In the beginning of the GRWM, Alix is visibly showing herself using Reale Actives skincare, while introducing what the GRWM will be about verbally. TikTok’s audiovisual format gives Alix Earle the affordance to communicate multiple messages simultaneously. She is able to feature and expose her products to her audience without having to explicitly mention them, allowing her audience to hear a different message she is trying to put out. This affordance of TikTok’s platform helps with the circulation of her brand without oversaturating her content with only marketing focused videos. Since the GRWM style is a major part of her brand already, it becomes another way to circulate her products without interrupting the casualness and familiarity of her content.
